answer.rationale: Run targeted, time-limited pricing offers for price-sensitive SMB accounts, since prior evidence shows promotional pricing can lift qualified revenue and current churn pressure is concentrated in this segment. Use guardrails on discount depth, eligibility, and duration, and monitor qualified revenue, gross margin, retention, and discount spillover. Signup simplification is also validated for SMBs but is unlikely to address the immediate competitor-driven price objection. Memory_73 remains unverified this cycle, so avoid a broad rollout.
